description: DataKey::QuorumReached(proposal_id) idempotency sentinel. Written once (value=true) on the first vote that brings votes_cast to or above quorum_threshold. Prevents re-emitting EventQuorumReached for subsequent votes on the same proposal. This key is additive — existing proposals without this key behave as if it is absent (not yet reached quorum); the sentinel is only written when quorum is first crossed. Rollback: deleting this key resets the idempotency guard for the proposal (re-emission would occur on next qualifying vote). Operators SHOULD NOT delete this key in production.
